Yes, from what you've described, you'd get the full $59 back.

Leafy Plus is fully refundable if you cancel within **14 days** of purchase or renewal **and** haven't used any membership benefits. You renewed 5 days ago, so you have about 9 days left in the window. If you haven't placed an order since renewing, you shouldn't have used any benefits, such as free shipping, free change-of-mind returns, member pricing on pots and accessories, or early access to a rare plant drop. If you've used any of those, there's no refund, though your benefits would continue to the end of the paid year.

- **Where the money goes:** The refund goes to your original payment method. Once it's issued, cards take **5-10 business days** and digital wallets **3-5 business days**.
- **Cancelling:** The policy I have doesn't say where to cancel Leafy Plus, so I don't want to guess. Please cancel soon, well before day 14. You can reach support by chat (8am-8pm Mon-Sat) or email at help@leafy.example (answered within 1 business day). I can also escalate this to a Support Lead if you'd like.
